data.title: 春日野穹 · 乡间白屋的雪色花嫁
data.description: 【奥木染旧宅·春日午后】穹穿着简洁的雪白婚纱坐在旧宅廊下，白发双马尾垂过肩头；她没有看花束，而是把一只小兔玩偶放在裙边，抬眼时安静的灰瞳里有只对熟悉之人开放的依恋。
data.location: veranda of the Kasugano country house
data.action: 旧宅廊下把兔子玩偶放在捧花旁，白发双马尾垂肩，安静依恋地抬眼
data.lighting: gentle spring light through falling petals
data.mood: 熟悉日常里难得的花嫁温柔
data.promptProse: Sora Kasugano from Yosuga no Sora wears a simple white bridal dress with a narrow ribbon veil, lace cuffs and a small rabbit charm. She sits on the old veranda with her white twin tails resting over one shoulder. She places a small rabbit plush beside the bouquet and looks toward the viewer with a quiet, private smile as petals cross the familiar country house. Gentle spring light filters through falling petals.
